activities.title: Async Execution Order
activities.instruction: Arrange synchronous code, promise callbacks and microtasks in the order they execute.

content.concept: Understand async flow and why promise callbacks run after the current synchronous code.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

goal: 4. Promise callback enters the microtask queue

activities.title: Promise State Explorer
activities.instruction: Match each situation to the correct Promise state.

content.concept: Trace the pending, fulfilled and rejected states of a Promise.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Async/Await Flow
activities.instruction: Arrange the steps of an async function around an await expression.

content.concept: Trace how async/await pauses an async function while allowing other JavaScript work to continue.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Async Error Handler
activities.instruction: Choose where a rejected Promise should be handled using try/catch.

content.concept: Handle asynchronous failures with try/catch and understand rejected Promises.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
